translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Irbogus Garda Narmaksad 2 Corintios

content: Degisoggu, we-arbaed Bab Dummad wile-anmar-dakedba anmarga uksasoggu, mer galakued an imakmarsun.

A-ulale ibmar-dukuar-imakleged-igar, degine, ibmar-dule-obingesaed-igar an metemarsun. An dulemar-gwen-yardakdisurmalad, degine, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba gwen an ogwadimarsurbalid. Suli, deyob an gudisurmalad. Unnila napiragwadbi Bab-Dummad-asabin an dulemar ibmar-mag-itogega an imakdiid.
Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued anba dulemarga dukuar maile, we-dulemar-amba-yoggus-gudidimaladga dukuar maido.

Ar amar we-gaya-burba-nued yapa abingamarsoggu, a-ulale bab-dummad-we-napneggined amar-binsaed-gassunnad, aku-ito imaksasunnad, adi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued-Cristo-yeer-daklegedgi-soglesadgi, a mer magar dakmalagar. We-Cristo Bab-Dummad-e-wilub-napiragwad-sunnadid.
Ar anmar na dukin anmargi na sunmaksurmalad, anmar-sunmakedi Jesucristogi an sunmakmalad, we-Jesucristo Dule-Dummadye, anmardi Jesús-sabed-ular be-maiga gumarsunye.
Ar Bab-Dummad-sunnad sogsad:
Gn. 1:3 A-Bab-Dummad-sunnad gwallu-mee anmar-gwagegi oganonikid, adi a-gwallubali Bab Dummad e-yeer-dakleged-Jesucristo-e-wagargi-gaed-ganaid mag anmar wisgumalagar.
Pablo beedse wiledi-inigwele, gwen bukib-itosulid
We-ibmar-nued anmar nikadi, anmar-san napsa-sobaledyobidgi we-ibmar-nued an sedimalad, adi mag dakmalagar, we-gangued-dummad Bab Dummadgi danikid, anmargi danisulid.
Degisoggu, anmar bonigan-abargi gudimar-inigwele, anmar geg egi nomar-deeye soglesulid. Anmar imbagwena suli-binsa-itononi-damar-inigwele, geg an bar guye gwen an sogdisurmalad.
Dulemar anmar-baregindimar-inigwele, Bab Dummad walagwen gwen an metedisurmalad. Anmar aimukud-damar-inigwele, gwen an-obelodisurmalad.
Ar anmar bia naoe, an wiledimaladgi anmar-sangi Jesús-burgwisad-e-wilubgan an sedigumalad, adi Jesús-dula-gudiid anmar-sangi mag daklegegar.
Anmar emi dula gudiidi, Jesús-nug-ulale anmar burgwed guagwar gudiid, adi anmar-san-sunna-berguedgi Jesús-dula-gudiid mag daklegegar.
Degisoggu, burgwed-abargi an gudiid, bemardi dula-gudiguega gunonisunnad.
Degi-inigwele, amba anmar Bab-Dummadgi-bensulid emalad. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:
Sal. 116:10 Debayobi an bengusurmosoggu, a-ular an sunmakmosunnad.
Anmar wisid, Bab Dummad, Dummad-Jesús-odulosad, a-Jesúsba Bab Dummad anmar-odulomogoed, degine, bemarmala Bab Dummad na e-asabin anmar-sedoed.

Bela-anmar-wilesadi bemarga ibmar-nueganga guegala deyob gusad, adi dulemar mag dakega Bab Dummad dulemargi nabir binsamaid. Degisoggu, dulemar Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogdagoedba Bab-Dummad-nug bela-bela ogannoledii-guoed.
A-ulale, anmar gwen galakussurmalad. Ar we-anmar-san-sanaled mommolema-inigwele, anmar-burbadi bane-bane gangumaid.
Ar wegi-an-wiledimaladi, dogdarsulid, unnila ichesaar an wiledimalad, bergudoed. An-wiledimalad-ular Bab Dummad degi-sadegu anmar-nug ogannogoed, anmarga ibmar-nuegan bur-bule ukoed.

Ar we-ibmar-nabir-ibyagi-daklemalad, agi anmar binsasulid, bur anmar binsaed ibmar-aku-daklemaladgi. Ar wegi ibmar-nabir-ibyagi-daklemaladdi bergudoed, ar ibmar-geg-ibyagi-daklemaladdi, adi degi-sadeguoed.
